name: Orb · SHDR-18
description: A crystal folded out of one eighth of space, tumbling: an absolute value on the sample reflects all eight octants together and a component-wise max against its own rolled swizzle creases the diagonals, so the field carries the full symmetry of an octahedron without a single mirror plane being written down. Both folds happen after an exact minus-90-degree Rodrigues rotation about an axis that wanders on the clock, so the mirror planes are carried around with it and the crystal genuinely tumbles rather than being a static mandala with a moving texture. Depth along the ray paints the hue (WebGL). Ported from Orbkit shdr-18 — shader by XorDev, non-commercial.
